description.en: A broad fossil flower has five large partially fused sepals with visible venation.
description.zh: 宽大化石花具五枚部分愈合大萼片及可见叶脉。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Florissantia, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Florissantia 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Five broad lobes around a shallow central cup differ from Dillhoffia's unlobed funnel calyx.
distinctness.zh: 浅中央杯周围五宽裂片区别于Dillhoffia无裂漏斗萼。

modeling_brief.en: Use a five-lobed low-relief sheet with raised major veins; keep small central organs conservative.
modeling_brief.zh: 用五裂浅浮雕薄片及隆起主脉建形，中央小器官保守处理。

uncertainty: Flower specimen only; no invented whole flowering tree or petal colour.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
